advisoryFindings.title: R2 metadata coverage is implicit
advisoryFindings.improvement: Add a metadata-specific assertion if the skill file has frontmatter or structured metadata, so the test verifies the metadata itself carries the explicit-start-only guidance rather than only matching the full file text.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current test reads the full skill file and checks for forbidden startup wording plus explicit-start guidance, so the requirement has meaningful coverage; the gap is precision rather than absence of coverage.
